warnings.message: the exercise schedule is not marked as confirmed, so these results are PROVISIONAL: an exercise date or price taken from a convention rather than from the documents changes the option value and the risk. Send exercise_terms_status='confirmed' once the terms are verified.

errors.message: the call schedule cannot be represented on this bond's model grid: its earliest exercise date 2011-12-02 falls after the last exercisable coupon date 2011-09-01 and before maturity 2012-03-01. The lattice exercises on coupon dates only, and never at maturity, so there is no node at which this right could be taken. It is refused rather than ignored — ignoring it prices a straight bond and reports the option as worth zero.
